name: zidni-catalog-platform
description: Product & category management API (NestJS + PostgreSQL) with an MCP server for AI agents

scripts.build: npm run build -w mcp-server && npm run build -w api
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w api && npm run lint -w mcp-server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w api && npm run typecheck -w mcp-server
scripts.test: npm run test -w mcp-server && npm run test -w api
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:mcp
scripts.docs:export: npm run openapi:export && npm run tools:export -w mcp-server
